authentication_smtp.evidence: The capacity model fits Resend Free, but combined Supabase Auth plus Resend custom-domain delivery and suppression behavior has not been measured in staging.

web_api_hosting.evidence: Paid Render services avoid the documented free idle sleep and supply a compatible Node service shape.
web_api_hosting.procedure: Compare render.yaml and repository runtimes with Render free, compute, and deploy documentation.
web_api_hosting.observed_result: Three always-on 0.5c-512mb services are required for the current Next, Express, and worker processes.

timely_executor.evidence: No authorized paid staging worker has run the one-minute/200-job/restart/stall scenario.

private_evidence_storage.evidence: Private-bucket access is documented, but raw-object deletion, cache, internal-copy, and retention behavior have not been tested in the candidate project.

independent_recovery_storage.evidence: Backblaze B2 is a separate provider/failure domain with S3 compatibility, encryption options, version retention, and Object Lock.
independent_recovery_storage.procedure: Review B2 pricing, S3 compatibility, Object Lock, lifecycle, and application-key documentation against the prototype assumptions.
independent_recovery_storage.observed_result: The candidate can represent immutable, versioned, minimally scoped receipt objects; live semantics remain a separate required check.

exports.evidence: Existing restored logical archives measured 94 KiB and 325 KiB; a conservative 10 MiB export rotation models 1.94 GiB.
exports.procedure: Measure retained rehearsal archives and model 168 hourly plus 30 daily 10 MiB encrypted exports.
exports.observed_result: Modeled storage remains below B2's first 10 GB; 25 MiB/export and 5 GiB total are mandatory re-price alerts.

independent_monitoring.evidence: Better Stack limits were reviewed, but no independent readiness, worker, or backup heartbeat has been configured and observed.

recovery_provider_semantics.evidence: No authorized B2 bucket/credentials were available for write/read/list, ambiguity, lock/delete, second-reader, or key-recovery tests.

representative_capacity.evidence: Backup bytes/operations and email volume were calculated from measured archives and a stated participant-trip workload rather than user count alone.
representative_capacity.procedure: Apply the worked backup and email model in the provider arrangement document.
representative_capacity.observed_result: 1.94 GiB modeled B2 storage, about 2,250 monthly storage operations, and a 600/month, 50/day email envelope fit candidate free allowances.

operating_restrictions.evidence: The arrangement records free idle sleep, email caps, laptop independence, raw-object deletion uncertainty, and monitoring/commercial-use gates.
operating_restrictions.procedure: Compare provider terms/limits with the pilot support, notification, recovery, and deletion invariants.
operating_restrictions.observed_result: Free-only is rejected; onboarding pauses at 50 emails/day; no deletion promise or real trip proceeds before live validation.

current_costs.evidence: The free result and current base/overage boundaries are separated with tax, FX, domain, and excluded-service assumptions.
current_costs.procedure: Read current primary pricing and calculate three Render services, Render Key Value, and Supabase Pro.
current_costs.observed_result: Base is USD 56/month; planning conversion is ₹5,600 before tax or ₹6,608 with assumed 18% tax at ₹100/USD.

operator_selection.evidence: The maintainer selected a zero-cost constraint and rejected the paid candidate, but has not selected a hosting topology or an evidenced reduced-window workflow.

staging_prerequisites.evidence: The topology, secret classes, operator inputs, synthetic-only staging sequence, checks, and handoff boundary are recorded without secrets.
staging_prerequisites.procedure: Review the staged runbook inputs against ticket 07 and the pilot launch gates.
staging_prerequisites.observed_result: The document identifies every provider component, credential class, live check, and non-authorization boundary required before staging.

recommendation.rationale: Reject the paid candidate under the maintainer's zero-cost constraint and retain the real-trip launch block because the reviewed components do not provide a validated free arrangement.
remaining_requirements: Select a specific free topology or evidenced reduced-window workflow; the budget constraint alone is not an arrangement selection.
Measure combined Supabase Auth and Resend custom-domain delivery/suppression behavior in staging.
Run the paid executor timing/restart/stall proof.
Configure and observe independent readiness, worker, and backup monitoring.
